name: Body Purification
body:
Discipline psychometabolism (healing); Level cryptic 2, gifted blade 2, marksman 2, psion/wilder 3, psychic warrior 2, vitalist 2

MANIFESTING

Display Auditory and material
Manifesting Time 1 round

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration Instantaneous
Power Points cryptic 3, gifted blade 3, marksman 3, psion/wilder 5, psychic warrior 3, vitalist 3

DESCRIPTION

You restore up to 2 points of damage to a single ability score. You cannot use body purification to heal ability drain.

Augment For every additional power point you spend, this power heals 1 additional point of damage to the same ability score.
